name: Khalifa Bin Butti Al Muhairi
forbes_bio: Khalifa Bin Butti Al Muhairi is the chairman of KBBO Group, an Abu Dhabi-based group with investments in healthcare, money exchange and retail.
He's a large shareholder in NMC Health, a London-listed firm that bills itself as the largest private healthcare provider in the U.A.E.
NMC, which runs hospitals and clinics in a dozen countries, was founded by B.R. Shetty, also a billionaire. Al Muhairi is an executive board member.
He has stakes in money transfer firm UAE Exchange, which handles nearly $30 billion in remittances annually, and U.K. money exchange firm Travelex.
He has partnered with billionaire Saeed Bin Butti Al Qebaisi to make investments through entities called Infinite Investment and Centurion Partners.
forbes_facts: After graduating from Suffolk University in Boston, he worked in finance at Abu Dhabi National Oil Company.
In 2014, he partnered with U.S. investment and advisory firm Guggenheim Partners in Dubai to offer financial services to Middle Eastern companies.

name: Xavier Rubiralta
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Xavier Rubiralta owes his fortune to Spain-based Werfen, a diagnostics company that specializes in hemostasis, acute care, transfusion, autoimmunity and transplants.
A member of Werfen's board since 2013, he inherited his stake in the company from his late father in 2012.
Werfen's roots stem from his father and uncle who founded the business in 1966 as a health products distributor; it went on to acquire U.S.-based Instrumentation Laboratory in 1991.
Each inheriting equal stakes from his father, his brother Jordi, Jose Luis and Marc are also billionaires.

name: Jared Kushner
forbes_bio: Jared Kushner is Donald Trump's son-in-law and the founder of Miami-based private equity firm Affinity Partners.
He launched Affinity in 2021 and the firm now manages more than $5.4 billion in assets as of September 2025.
The firm has raised $4.6 billion from high-profile Middle Eastern backers like the Saudi and Qatari sovereign wealth funds as well as Foxconn founder Terry Gou.
From 2008 to 2017, he worked as the CEO of Kushner Companies, the real estate company cofounded by his father and grandfather.
He served as a senior advisor to Donald Trump during the president's first term from 2017 to 2021.
forbes_facts: Kushner and his wife, Ivanka, own a home near Jeff Bezos on Miami's "billionaire bunker" Indian Creek island.
Kushner used to own a stake in his brother Josh's venture capital firm Thrive Capital, which he sold before joining the Trump administration in 2017.

name: Jin Lei
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2020-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026); Hurun China (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Jin Lei is CEO of GenSci Pharmaceutical, a manufacturer of recombinant human growth hormone.
GenSci went public by merging with Shenzhen-listed Changchun High & New Technology Industries Group in 2019.
Jin holds a master's degree from the Chinese Academy of Sciences and a Ph.D. from University of California.
After receiving a doctorate, Jin worked for biomedical firm Genentech in the U.S.
Jin returned to China in 1995 and co-founded GeneScience Pharmaceuticals with funding from Changchun High and New Tech in 1996.

name: Mehmet Nazif Gunal
name_chinese: 穆罕默德·纳粹夫·古纳尔
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2012-2021); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Through Mapa Group, Mehmet Nazif Gunal is active in a variety of sectors including hospitality, construction, transportation and energy production.
He received a civil engineering degree in 1971 and established his own construction firm, eventually taking on projects throughout the Middle East.
Mapa (formerly MNG Holding) owns 10 five-star hotels concentrated in Turkey's most important tourism regions.
Gunal is a proponent of generating energy through river-based turbines. Mapa's hydropower plants have a total installed capacity of 164 MWH.
Gunal's Avesoro Holdings mines gold in Africa, with two operations in Liberia and one in Burkina Faso.
forbes_facts: Operating under the World of Wonders brand name, his Kremlin Palace and Topkapi Palace hotels in Antalya are architecturally exact replicas of their namesakes.
Mapa is one of five main contractors on the new Istanbul Airport--the largest infrastructure project ever undertaken in Turkey.

name: Ashok Kajaria
forbes_bio: Ashok Kajaria is the chairman and managing director of listed Kajaria Ceramics, which was founded by him in 1988.
The company is India's largest manufacturer of ceramic tiles, which it manufactures in eight factories across the country.
Both his sons Chetan and Rishi help him run the company as joint managing directors.
Bollywood actor Ranveer Singh  is Kajaria's brand ambassador.
forbes_facts: Kajaria is a U.S.-educated mechanical engineer.
The company's factories have a combined annual capacity to make more than 70 million square meters of tiles.
